description: Synthetic retrieval-quality corpus. Invented content. Each query is a reworded question with one expected document.

documents.title: Travel Receipts
documents.text: Travel expense receipts must be submitted within 30 days of the end of the trip. Late submissions need a manager's note.

documents.title: Travel Class
documents.text: Employees fly economy class on flights shorter than six hours. Business class needs director approval.

documents.title: Hotel Cap
documents.text: Hotel stays are reimbursed up to 180 euros per night in major cities and 120 euros elsewhere.

documents.title: Meal Allowance
documents.text: A daily meal allowance of 45 euros applies on business trips. Alcohol is never reimbursed.

documents.title: Annual Leave
documents.text: Full-time staff receive 25 days of paid annual leave per year. Unused days carry over until March.

documents.title: Sick Leave
documents.text: Staff who are ill should notify their manager before 10:00. A medical certificate is required after three days.

documents.title: Parental Leave
documents.text: Parents may take up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, taken within the first year after the birth or adoption.

documents.title: Remote Work
documents.text: Employees may work remotely up to three days a week with their manager's agreement. Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00.

documents.title: Password Policy
documents.text: Passwords need at least 14 characters and are changed only if compromised. Multi-factor sign-in is mandatory for all systems.

documents.title: Device Security
documents.text: Company laptops must use full-disk encryption and lock after five minutes of inactivity. Lost devices are reported to IT within 24 hours.

documents.title: Phishing
documents.text: Suspicious emails are forwarded to the security mailbox and not opened. Never enter credentials on a page reached from an email link.

documents.title: Data Classes
documents.text: Documents are classed public, internal, confidential or restricted. Restricted documents may only be shared with named individuals.

documents.title: Procurement Limit
documents.text: Purchases above 5,000 euros need three quotes and finance approval. Purchases below 500 euros need no quote.

documents.title: Vendor Onboarding
documents.text: New vendors complete a security questionnaire and sign a data processing agreement before any personal data is shared.

documents.title: Expense Approval
documents.text: Expense claims over 1,000 euros need approval from a director in addition to the line manager.

documents.title: Fire Safety
documents.text: On hearing the fire alarm, leave the building by the nearest exit and gather at the assembly point in the car park.

documents.title: First Aid
documents.text: First aiders are listed at reception and on every floor. Report every workplace injury in the incident log the same day.

documents.title: Visitor Policy
documents.text: Visitors sign in at reception, wear a badge and are escorted at all times in secure areas.

documents.title: Office Hours
documents.text: The office is open from 08:00 to 18:00 on working days. Badge access outside these hours needs facilities approval.

documents.title: Holiday Calendar
documents.text: Public holidays follow the national calendar. The office also closes between Christmas and New Year.

documents.title: Code Review
documents.text: All changes to production code need a review by a second engineer and passing automated tests before release.

documents.title: Incident Response
documents.text: Security incidents are reported to the on-call engineer, who assigns a severity and opens an incident channel within 30 minutes.

documents.title: Data Retention
documents.text: Customer records are kept for seven years after the contract ends and then deleted. Backups are purged after 90 days.

documents.title: Board Acquisition
documents.text: The board approved exploratory talks with an acquisition target at a price ceiling of 40 million. Details are restricted to board members.
